item.title: Tranmere Rovers 2-7 Runcorn Linnets | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Tranmere Rovers 2-7 Runcorn Linnets, Liverpool Senior Cup Quarter-Final Runcorn Linnets were awarded a penalty on the half-hour mark. Naim Arsan placed it into the bottom-left corner despite Charlie Jones diving the right way. The visitors added to their lead two minutes later, with former Tranmere Rovers player Elliot Rokka finishing from close range. Rovers won a penalty themselves in the 37th minute. item.title: Crewe Alexandra 2-1 Tranmere Rovers | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Crewe Alexandra 2-1 Tranmere Rovers Tommi O’Reilly was the standout player for Crewe in the first half, and he had the first shot on target of the afternoon, forcing Marko Marosi into a near-post save. James Plant gave Rovers the lead in the 44th minute with his first goal for the Club, riffling the ball home left-footed, nutmegging Ian Lawlor.
